digests.title: TLDR Daily Digest
digests.tagline: Tech, AI, IT, Web Dev, InfoSec, DevOps

stories.headline: OpenAI Launches Agents API Beta
stories.blurb: OpenAI has launched its Agents API in public beta, providing developers with a managed framework to build, orchestrate, and reliably run long-running AI agents.

stories.headline: OpenAI Introduces GPT-Live-1 for Voice Agents
stories.blurb: OpenAI introduced GPT-Live-1, a $0.05-per-minute API model enabling full-duplex speech, real-time interruption handling, and dynamic tone control for voice agents.

stories.headline: SWE-2 Redefines Cost and Performance on Coding Benchmarks
stories.blurb: Cognition's new SWE-2 coding agent dramatically improves on current state-of-the-art software engineering benchmarks while running at a fraction of the cost of leading frontier models.

stories.headline: AI Safety Warnings Heighten Over Threat of Catastrophic Loss of Control
stories.blurb: Prominent alignment researchers at Anthropic and OpenAI are warning that there is a significant chance advanced AI could cause a catastrophic loss of human control within the decade.

stories.headline: Shopify Abandons React Native for Fully Native Mobile Apps
stories.blurb: Shopify is shifting major mobile apps from React Native back to fully native Swift and Kotlin codebases, finding that AI coding agents make maintaining separate native apps highly cost-effective.

stories.headline: PlanetScale Announces Neki for Sharded Postgres
stories.blurb: PlanetScale has announced Neki, an open-source sharded PostgreSQL solution that behaves like a single-server database while horizontally scaling across thousands of nodes.

stories.headline: Microsoft Designates Rust as a Tier-1 Language
stories.blurb: Microsoft has officially designated Rust as a Tier-1 language, granting internal developers a paved path through secure toolchains, platform integrations, and production workflows.

stories.headline: NVIDIA Unveils CUDA Rust for GPU Kernels
stories.blurb: NVIDIA has announced CUDA Rust, allowing developers to write and optimize high-performance GPU compute kernels directly in Rust to leverage compile-time memory safety.

stories.headline: Cloudflare Rolls Out Automatic Post-Quantum Key Exchange
stories.blurb: Cloudflare launched Automatic Key Exchange, automatically upgrading origin connection handshakes to post-quantum encryption and cutting latency by over 150 ms at p90.

stories.headline: Anthropic Disrupts Attempts to Use Claude for Biological Weaponry
stories.blurb: Anthropic’s latest threat report details the company's recent actions to disrupt multiple efforts by bad actors to use Claude for biological weapons research and automated cyberattacks.

stories.headline: WebGPU "Deathray" Exploit Freezes Apple M-Series Macs
stories.blurb: A simple WebGPU exploit dubbed "Deathray" can completely lock the graphics stack on M-series Macs across Safari, Chrome, and Firefox, forcing a physical machine restart.

stories.headline: Google Plans $15B Finland Infrastructure and Nuclear Power Study
stories.blurb: Google plans to invest $15 billion into Finnish AI infrastructure and is exploring nuclear energy partnerships to reliably power the massive buildout.

stories.headline: LG Denies Allegations of Constant Smart TV Microphone Recording
stories.blurb: LG has strongly denied claims from an online investigation alleging that its smart TVs constantly log network traffic and capture ambient audio even when in standby mode.
